svg.text: ETSI EN 304 6xx (CRA product categories, M/606): stage history and outlook
Stage of every draft version and milestone in the ETSI work programme. Y axis, bottom to top: work item, early, stable, mature and final draft, TB endorsed,
enquiry, review, EC check, vote, published (harmonised standard), cited in the OJ (presumption of conformity). Red: a step back (a new draft at a lower stage).
Grey: typical path of 29 ETSI hENs on the same path, anchored at ETSI's planned publication. Dotted: M/606 deadline 30 Oct 2026, amended 31 Jan 2027, CRA applies 11 Dec 2027.

svg.text: Our estimate: the steps still open at the durations seen on these standards (resolving the EC/HAS comments 85 d, then 15 d to the EC check, which takes 59 d), ETSI's planned 64 d to publication and the typical 299 d to
the OJ; lighter: one more round of EC/HAS comments.

Source: ETSI work programme (eWPM schedules of the work items, read daily; data as of 26 Nov 2026). Typical path: 29 ETSI harmonised standards on the same path, published since 2019 (reference set of 24 Nov 2026).
